notes: Background: Cedarbridge builds a product analytics layer for mid-market SaaS platforms. Heavy similarity search + reranking to surface product insights and automated change summaries for PMs.
Initial traction: started on Redwood hosted API (low-traffic prod trial). Team liked streaming & embeddings; noted consistent latency but wants predictable cost/throughput as they scale.

CTO quote: 'Hosted was a fantastic way to validate quality. We need Dedicated for throughput and isolation — but must preserve the same API ergonomics and be able to rollback fast if model changes regress.'

POC objective: verify Dedicated will meet throughput SLO and maintain quality parity vs hosted baseline. Measure: latency P95, end-to-end request throughput, token cost per 1M tokens, and embedding recall vs current Faiss baseline.

POC scope (high level): 2-week Dedicated POC in US-west; 10k daily queries synthetic + 2k real user queries; canary rollout to 10% traffic for first 48 hours, then 50% for 24 hours, full traffic by final acceptance if metrics OK.
Canary & fallback plan (required by Cedarbridge):
- Canary: route 10% of traffic to Dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-a) behind a canary flag in their proxy. Observe model quality and latency for 48h.
- Fallback routing: if latency or quality regressions observed, auto-fallback to Redwood hosted API model-compat layer (hosted-compat-v1) with routing priority; SE to validate prefix+KV cache parity.
- Model variants: primary model for POC = rdx-bert-large-quantized (recommended), fallback variant = rdx-bert-medium-compat; also test openhf-llama-compat as last resort in overloaded scenarios.

- Region failover: primary Dedicated in us-west; planned failover to eu-west Dedicated instance if we detect region-wide capacity event or sustained p99 latency > 800ms for 10m window. Failover to hosted EU as secondary fallback.

- Rollback triggers: any drop in eval-set F1 > 2.0% vs baseline OR sustained P95 latency increase > 250ms OR error rate > 0.5% for 15 minutes. Rollback to previous model version + route traffic to hosted-compat.
Acceptance criteria for POC (explicit):
- Latency: P95 end-to-end < 350ms for generation; P99 < 700ms in steady state
- Throughput: sustained 120 requests/sec with <=5% tail-error
- Quality: embedding recall @K=50 >= hosted baseline -1.0% (measured on product-queries-POC set)
- Cost: token unit cost for Dedicated stack projected <= hosted baseline * 0.75 at target throughput (expectation from Redwood Optimize estimates)

Operational notes: infra team requested a small IP allowlist, KMS integration for inference logs, and audit log ingestion to their SIEM (Splunk). Security requires retention controls and data residency in US only for this POC.

Open items / blockers: legal wants explicit language around ephemeral KV cache retention (SEC-1876), budget owner (VP Rev Ops) scheduled review 2026-03-15, need performance test results from eu-west before enabling region failover.
Next steps (short): sign Dedicated POC SOW, schedule infra handoff call (SE + infra eng), run baseline perf harness on hosted -> capture seeds for parity tests.
